source_en: Hello. ...You are new. I keep track of faces.
Emzar Jalaghonia. Beekeeper's assistant, east side. The master runs the hives.
He does not use his name. Says names make people complicated.
Clean frames. Stand near the hives until they adjust. ...They adjust.
My [[infected:chest's been tight]]. The dust, the foreman says. ...I also do construction.
...The lines at the polyclinic are long. The master says urgency gets people stung.
Quiet. Since the blast they stay inside. ...Good day.
